policy: Standard spelling of edicion (trim) so the same trim counts on one row (Max 2026-10-08). Only high-confidence abbreviations and typos of the SAME trim of the SAME brand+model. Powertrain is part of the row key: nothing here merges rows of different powertrains. Distinct trims are never merged; doubtful pairs are listed in 'doubtful' and left as they are. Applied after the base-model/edicion split (modelo_base.py); rows that end up with the same (period, variant, segmento, marca, modelo, edicion, powertrain, condicion) are summed.

notes.NISSAN|X-TRAIL E-POWER: Nissan Paraguay sells the X-Trail e-POWER only as Advance e-4ORCE and Exclusive e-4ORCE (nissan.com.py); e-4ORCE is the 4x4 system, so '4X4' and 'E-4ORCE' are the same trim.
notes.AUDI: Q6 E-TRON / Q8 E-TRON / E-TRON: SB = Sportback, SLINE = S line, ADVANCED and PERFOMANCE/PERMORMANCE are typos. Numbers 50/55 are the power level, kept.
notes.TESLA: SR = Standard Range, LR = Long Range, PAWD = Premium AWD; Performance stays Performance.
notes.HYUNDAI|CRETA: Base CRETA for CRETA / NEW CRETA (NEW = same model, Max 2026-10-08). Trims COMFORT, PLATINUM, ACTION, GLS; fuel/engine words (NAFTERO, NAFT, NAFTA, FLEX, 15CC, AT) are dropped, never kept in edicion. No spelling aliases needed.
notes.CHEVROLET|CORVETTE E-RAY: HEV Corvette = E-Ray (the only hybrid Corvette); ERAY → E-RAY; edicion = CONVERTIBLE/COUPE where stated. ICE Corvettes unchanged.
notes.NISSAN|NEW KICKS: 2nd-gen Kicks (220T). Base NEW KICKS; edicion SENSE / ADVANCE / ADVANCE PLUS / EXCLUSIVE; engine/gearbox/fuel words (220T, 6 DCT, FLEX) dropped (Max 2026-10-08 round 5).
notes.fuel_words: Fuel/accessory/gearbox words (NAFT, NAFTA, NAFTERO, DIESEL, GASOLINA, FLEX, MOVIDO A …, CON SUS ACCESORIOS …, AUT/AT/MT/CVT/DCT, 16CC) never go into modelo or edicion (Max 2026-10-08 round 5).
